title: Configuring the CrowdStrike Falcon Insights Connector

blocks.text: The CrowdStrike Falcon Insights connector integrates with your CrowdStrike platform to retrieve raw telemetry, system events, and alerts for use within the Agentic SOC application in the Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform). This allows Agentic SOC to detect and respond to endpoint-based threats, including malware, ransomware, and credential theft.

To configure the CrowdStrike Falcon Insights connector, ensure that you have active Internet & SaaS (ZIA) and Agentic SOC accounts. You also need an active Falcon Data Replicator add-on subscription from CrowdStrike and the source authentication configuration. To create the API keys and Falcon Data Replicator feed, you need to have a Falcon Administrator role or be assigned the correct permissions.

blocks.item: Falcon Data Replicator Feed Client ID, Secret, and Notifications URL
Falcon Data Replicator forwards your CrowdStrike data to an S3 bucket.
To create a Falcon Data Replicator feed:
Log in to the CrowdStrike console.
Go to Menu > Support and resources > Falcon data replicator.
Click Create feed.
The Create feed window appears.
In the Create feed window:
Feed name: Enter a name.
Feed: Enable to activate the feed.
Click Next.

Review the feed's default settings. Changing the default settings can result in Agentic SOC not having the necessary data to make proper threat analysis, limiting its ability to protect your environment.
Click Create feed.
Copy the client ID, secret, and notifications URL to be used in the connector setup process.
Save the secret securely as you cannot copy or view it later.
To learn more, refer to the CrowdStrike documentation.
API Client ID and Secret
To generate the API client ID and secret:
Log in to the CrowdStrike console.
Go to Menu > Support and resources > Client Management.
Click Create API client.
The Create API client window appears.
In the Create API client window:
Client Name: Enter a name.
Description: Enter a description.
In the Scope table, set the following permissions:
Alerts: Read and Write
Detections: Read and Write
Hosts: Read and Write
Host Groups: Read
NGSIEM: Read and Write
Threatgraph: Read
Click Create.
Copy the client ID and secret to be used in the connector setup process.
Save the secret securely as you cannot copy or view it later.
To learn more, refer to the CrowdStrike documentation.

blocks.text: To learn more, see Zscaler and CrowdStrike Deployment Guide.
To create the CrowdStrike Falcon Insights data source in the Agentic SecOps Platform:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Configure.
In the left-side navigation, click Sources.
Click Create.
The Create New Data Source page appears.
On the Create New Data Source page, search for and select the CrowdStrike Falcon Insights connector tile from the available data sources.
See image.

blocks.text: After you create the CrowdStrike Falcon Insights data source, enter the following information in the source setup Retrieval section:

blocks.item: Authentication
In the Authentication section, click Create New.
The CrowdStrike FDR Authentication window appears.
In the CrowdStrike FDR Authentication window, enter the information from the Prerequisites section.
See image.
Click Create.
After the data source is saved, you can't change its authentication. To use a different authentication, delete the existing data source and create a new one.
To learn more, see Configuring Authentication for Data Sources and Outegrations and Managing Authentication for Data Sources and Outegrations.
CID
To find your Customer ID (CID) in CrowdStrike:
Log in to the CrowdStrike console.
Click the user icon, then click your email address.
The User profile page appears. The CID details are displayed at the bottom of the page.

Agentic SOC supports multi-CID accounts where each CID has its own FDR feed and S3 bucket. Because of the CrowdStrike integration technical requirements, Agentic SOC cannot support an aggregated Falcon Data Replicator feed for multi-CID accounts. You must create new CrowdStrike Falcon Insight connectors for each CID you want to integrate.
